text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Take thiiis! Good-Fortune Dragon God Water 
Blast! 
Ahhahahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! With this, guard up...! Matsukawa 
Flounder-chan is right by my side, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my, so full of energy. 
Fufufu, do your best, both of you~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Giggle... with everything that happened, 
it feels like a dream...! 
No, maybe it's precisely *because* of 
everything we went through...!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you're all so lively♪ 
Everyone really, truly gave it their all!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You too, Falcon-san. 
Once again, thank you for all your hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Flash-san. 
I'm glad the two of us aren't cut from the 
exact same cloth, you know?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Where did that come from so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No reason! 
Just watching everyone made me think of 
it, kinda.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just kinda, is it? 
Well... I feel the same way.
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Holding it again this year! The 'Midsummer 
Beach Dirt Fest'!! 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Appointed! As prominent Dirt Umamusume of 
our era, 
I expect you, as representatives of our 
academy, to liven up this event with 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey☆ Lucky☆ A big, giant OKAYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Instant response!? —Wait, don't jump 
around like that! 
You're in front of the Chairwoman, stand 
up straight.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Rickey-chan is as energetic as ever. 
Now then, um, was this 'fest' a 'dirt 
festival' again?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Correct! 
It is an annual PR project organized by 
the URA to further boost the popularity of 
dirt racing!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! We do 'battles on the sand' that 
you never see in normal dirt races, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A 1600m big curve right along the water's 
edge! 
Beach flags with sand and seawater flying 
everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Live art carving huge sand sculptures with 
Umamusume power! 
Bare-handed hole-digging showdowns, and 
all kinds of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's super exciting every year, so I 
always thought, 'Someday, I want in too!' 
So...! A big, giant OK☆!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you actually understood what it was 
before agreeing. 
I totally thought you just blurted it out 
without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Depending on my schedule, I would love to 
participate as well. 
As a local idol, I want to actively tackle 
any and all events!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd gladly join too. 
It's such a precious invitation. Truly 
grateful, truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Appreciation! High expectations! By the 
way... 
Aside from you all, a participant from 
last year will also be making a guest 
appearance!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: From last year... Ah, could it be!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Oooooh Fight!! 
...Thank you so much, everyone~~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Before heading into the next song, here's 
an announcement☆ 
Falco will be making a guest appearance at 
the 'Midsummer Beach Dirt Fest'!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Who came to see me last year~? ...Oh, 
quite a lot of you! 
You can't miss this year's Falco either! 
Come chase me all the way to the beach~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Dashing smartly into your heart♪ 
It's Smart Falcon☆ Great to be working 
with you all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was you, Falco-san! 
We're so glad to be working with you!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon-san is scheduled to perform 
one song on the live stage as our guest.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ 
Falco got to do a whole solo live last 
year, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I watched the stream! It was simply 
breathtaking...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A two-hour passionate performance...! The 
whole venue was united with your 
call-and-response, it was incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aww, you're making Falco blush☆ 
It was so worth all the hard work~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could do something like that, 
too... 
I'd get so much more attention as a local 
idol, and Tomakomai's name would get out 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we give this 
year's live stage slot to Tarumae-san for 
a solo live!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: R-Really? Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No objections here! Go all out and hype up 
the crowd! 
As for me... I want to make sand art!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With sand sculptures, you can place as 
many lucky motifs as you want in any 
direction you like! 
Everyone gets super lucky☆ No doubt about 
it☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then I suppose I'll go with beach 
flags. 
A showdown with the local Umamusume...! 
Oho, I'm getting fired up~!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Everything's coming together so quickly! 
Then let's move forward with these three 
main events as our core—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A solo live... for me... 
On such a massive outdoor stage...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that wonderful, Tarumae-chan! 
It's a huge opportunity, so you gotta grab 
hold of it tight♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'll make sure it's an absolute 
success!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
—That covers most of it. 
By the way, where is the person Falcon-san 
recommended...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She said she'd arrive at the half-hour 
mark... Ah, five seconds left! 
Four, three, two, one...!
—Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have been assigned to accompany you as a 
coordinator and support staff— 
I am Eishin Flash. It is a pleasure to 
work with you.
